request.spec:
Show on each person their settled-total (the due of their SETTLED claims that count, at
their frozen figures, corrections included) and their open-total (the due of their OPEN and
PENDING claims that count: a held, deferred or retired-and-excluded claim is left out as it is
from the due-total). Show the sheet's settled-total and open-total too, each simply everyone's
figure added up (not trimmed). The two must add up to the person's untrimmed due-total before the
cap.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show on each person their settled-total (the due of their SETTLED claims that count, at
their frozen figures, corrections included) and their open-total (the due of their OPEN and
PENDING claims that count: a held, deferred or retired-and-excluded claim is left out as it is
from the due-total). Show the sheet's settled-total and open-total too, each simply everyone's
figure added up (not trimmed). The two must add up to the person's untrimmed due-total before the
cap.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each person now shows a settled-total and an open-total, and the sheet shows both totals as well. All 4 acceptance tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

The change is only in the front end. The server and stored data already had what was needed, so they're unchanged.

- **Per person** (`src/main/frontend/features/people/useSheetFigures.ts`):
  - **Settled-total** adds up the due of their SETTLED claims that count, at the frozen figures, corrections included.
  - **Open-total** adds up the due of their OPEN and PENDING claims that count.
  - Both use the same per-claim figures and the same "counts" rule as the due-total. So held, deferred and retired-and-excluded claims are left out, and the two always add up to the person's due-total before the cap.
  - A claim whose due is n/a adds nothing. Unlike the due-total, these two always show a number, never n/a.
- **Sheet totals:** the two sheet figures are everyone's figure added up. Unlike the sheet's due-total, they don't drop the highest and lowest person.
- **Display** (`src/main/frontend/features/people/PeopleList.tsx`): each person's row has new "Settled" and Open" columns next to Excess. The sheet's two totals sit below the due total.
